Satoshi's opinion was that the value of BTC would either be very, very high or probably worthless. Everyday that passes it is looking more likely that the outcome will be positive. That being said...DO NOT invest more than you can afford to lose! Don't just listen to me. Learn about it until YOU understand why this tech has value, otherwise you will be shaken easily and sell at a loss out of fear.
